subject: 해커스 수능영어독해 미니모의고사
title: 11회 6번 · 빈칸 추론하기
fullPassage: Disparate perspectives on the motivations and effects of historical events will always persist, and nowhere is this more evident than in the example of colonialism. In 2017, a British professor proposed a research project on the contributions of colonialism in order to challenge the idea that the British Empire was imperialist and unethical in its domination over Africa. In support of its legitimacy, the professor argued that the empire played a key role in the abolition of slavery by suppressing the slave trade after 1807. But the African people told a different story. It was their relentless resistance that contributed most to their liberation. The empire eventually passed the abolition law, yet it was just a response to the pressure created by decades of slave protests and international condemnation. As such, events like these cannot be adequately explained by a one-sided narrative. For a thorough understanding of events, it is imperative to recognize the difference in perspectives among the parties involved.
